subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the Microsoft Teams Graph media fallback for non-personal messages be enabled broadly, or should it require an explicit `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` opt-in while combining the channel URL fixes from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738?
rationale: Repository policy treats new config/default/fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and the two open candidate PRs encode different tradeoffs that automation should not choose silently.

options.title: Combine channel fixes with opt-in fallback
options.body: Use the channel team GUID and thread-reply URL fixes from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738, then gate the extra no-marker Graph fetch with the documented default-off setting from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096.

options.title: Land broad fallback behavior
options.body: Accept the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 shape if maintainers want channel and group non-personal messages to try Graph automatically when direct media extraction yields nothing.

options.title: Split group-chat scope
options.body: Land the channel-specific fix first and keep group-chat no-marker fallback as a separate follow-up if maintainers want more evidence before adding or enabling a config surface.

recommendation.title: Combine channel fixes with opt-in fallback
recommendation.body: Use the channel team GUID and thread-reply URL fixes from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738, then gate the extra no-marker Graph fetch with the documented default-off setting from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-line blame and recent release/current-main history put Vincent closest to the affected Teams media code and config-sensitive review path.
